HISTORICAL COMPARISON ONLY — not current law
Shows pre-amendment rule: no notification requirement, no QI requirement, no MFA, no detailed risk assessment criteria. Used to demonstrate scope of 2021/2023 changes.

Added QI, detailed risk assessment, MFA, encryption, continuous monitoring/pen testing, IRP, board reporting, service provider periodic assessment. Effective dates: most provisions Dec 9, 2022; some June 9, 2023.

Added §314.4(j) notification requirement; §314.2(m) notification event definition; effective May 13, 2024. 500-consumer threshold; 30-day deadline from discovery; written LE determination required for public disclosure delay.
